fast_swipe.description: Hand centroid jumps from x=0.15 to x=0.85 in 6 frames, then holds.

hand_lost_midway.description: 20 frames of hand_present=false in the middle of an otherwise steady DRAW pose.

out_of_bounds.description: Hand centroid slides from (0.5, 0.5) to (-0.20, 1.25), off-frame in both axes.

pinch_approach_release.description: Thumb-index spacing ratio sweeps through the zoom-lock thresholds, then the index finger releases.

static_jitter.description: Hand held still at (0.5, 0.5) plus fixed-seed per-landmark Gaussian noise (sigma=0.004).

threshold_chatter.description: Index PIP angle oscillates +-3 deg around the 120 deg OPEN/CLOSED threshold every frame.
